POP3 Client

gxsPOP3Client reads mail over TLS only: implicit TLS on port 995 or STLS on port 110.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

With gxsMAIL_STARTTLS a server that does not accept STLS is refused. Multi-line replies are read to the terminating dot and un-stuffed.

gxsPOP3Client pop3;
std::string msg;
if(pop3.Connect("mail.example.com") == 0 && pop3.Login("user", "pw") == 0 &&
   pop3.Retr(1, msg) == 0)
  std::cout << msg;
pop3.Quit();
